theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_graph_cone_hausdorff_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ξ : Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (Λ : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ v w, T₀.starProjection (ι v + ι' w) = ι v) → 0 ≤ Λ → Λ ≤ 1 → (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ Λ * ‖v - w‖) → (∀ x ∈ range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)), ∀ x' ∈ range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)), ‖(x - x') - T₀.starProjection (x - x')‖ ≤ Λ * ‖x - x'‖) ∧ (∀ x ∈ range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)), ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μHE[n] (range (fun v => ξ + ι v + ι' (f v)) ∩ closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))
